Every floor a new world.

Onyx's Pixel Dungeon holds content from more than 60 Pixel Dungeon mods. That is a lot to take in at once, so a new copy starts out as plain Shattered Pixel Dungeon, with Shattered's six heroes, challenges and floors. A window on first launch explains this.

**Beat Yog-Dzewa on floor 25 to open everything else.** After that most floors are built in a world from another mod, picked from those its mod made for that stage of the dungeon. The world sets the look and music, and your actual depth still sets the danger. The mod heroes, game modes, the boss crawl and tower defense all unlock at the same time, and the Mods button on the title screen lists every mod in the game.

**Already installed version 0.2.1 or later?** Just launch the game. It updates itself.

**Windows.** Download **Download-Me.zip**, unzip it, and run **Play.bat**. Java is included. If SmartScreen warns you, click **More info** and then **Run anyway**.

**Smaller Windows download.** `OnyxPixelDungeon-<version>-Windows-Installer.zip` downloads the official Shattered Pixel Dungeon runtime from GitHub, sets the game up, and adds a desktop shortcut. Unzip it and run **Install.bat**.

Both Windows downloads check for new versions each time you launch from Play.bat or the shortcut, so you only need to download once.

**Mac or Linux.** With Java 11 or newer installed, run `java -jar OnyxPixelDungeon-<version>.jar`. On a Mac, add `-XstartOnFirstThread` before `-jar`.
